name: Coca-Cola
notes: Largest global beverage company, selling through bottling partners and retailers worldwide. Illustrative account: standardized on the core platform for category reporting; analytics owned by strategy/finance. Whitespace: workflow automation for supply-chain alerting across bottler networks.

name: PepsiCo
type: Global snack and beverage manufacturer (public: PEP)
notes: Diversified food and beverage company (Frito-Lay, Quaker, Pepsi). Illustrative account: platform plus automation for demand and supply alerts. Whitespace: analytics for pricing and share across the snacks and beverage portfolios.

name: Keurig Dr Pepper
type: Beverage and coffee systems company (public: KDP)
notes: North American beverage and single-serve coffee company undergoing portfolio changes. Illustrative account: core platform only. Whitespace: integrations for any acquired or separated business units; analytics for category performance.

name: Procter & Gamble
type: Global household and personal-care manufacturer (public: PG)
notes: One of the largest consumer-goods companies, with brands like Tide, Pampers, and Gillette. Illustrative account: broad deployment across brand teams. Whitespace: workflow automation for retailer-specific alerts.

name: Walmart
notes: Largest US retailer by revenue, with a growing e-commerce and retail-media business. Illustrative account: platform plus POS and e-commerce integrations. Whitespace: analytics for pricing and demand; automation for merchant workflows.

name: Costco
notes: Membership warehouse club with international expansion and a high-volume private label (Kirkland Signature). Illustrative account: core platform only. Whitespace: analytics for member and category insight; integrations for new-market rollouts.

name: Target
notes: Large US general-merchandise and grocery retailer with strong owned brands. Illustrative account: platform plus analytics for merchandising. Whitespace: workflow automation and integrations for supply-chain and store operations.

name: Kroger
notes: Largest US traditional supermarket operator, with a large private-label and retail-media business and a recent merger history. Illustrative account: platform plus automation for store and supply alerts. Whitespace: analytics for pricing and demand; integrations for acquired banners.
